[⤓ Download this module as a book (PDF)](../../pdf/m06.pdf){.book-download}

**Prerequisites:** [M05 Mathematics for Data Science (R)](m05.qmd) · **GPU:** none

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | [Introduction to Probability Theory](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/01-Introduction%20to%20Probability%20Theory.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Probability axioms, conditional probability, Bayes reasoning, random variables, expected value and variance. |
| 02 | [Descriptive Statistics and Data Summary](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/02-Descriptive%20Statistics%20and%20Data%20Summary.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Center, spread, quantiles, distribution summaries, and charts. |
| 03 | [Basics of Data Visualization](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/03-Basics%20of%20Data%20Visualization.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | Core plotting principles and visual data communication in R. |
| 04 | [Basic Probability Distributions](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/04-Basic%20Probability%20Distributions.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Normal, binomial, Poisson, uniform, and related distributions. |
| 05 | [Central Limit Theorem and Sampling](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/05-Central%20Limit%20Theorem%20and%20Sampling.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Sampling distributions, standard error, and CLT-based inference. |
| 06 | [Sampling Distributions and Confidence Intervals](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/06-Sampling%20Distributions%20and%20Confidence%20Intervals.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | t, chi-square and F distributions, confidence intervals for means, proportions and variances, and the CI-test duality. |
| 07 | [Introduction to Hypothesis Testing](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/07-Introduction%20to%20Hypothesis%20Testing.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Null hypothesis setup, p-values, Type I/II errors, one-sided tests, reporting results, and p-hacking. |
| 08 | [Test Selection Flowchart](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/08-Test%20Selection%20Flowchart.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Structured statistical test selection by data type and assumptions. |
| 09 | [Assumption Checks](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/09-Assumption%20Checks.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Normality, homogeneity, independence, and diagnostic checks before testing. |
| 10 | [Two-Group Comparisons](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/10-Two-Group%20Comparisons.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | t-test families, non-parametric alternatives, and effect size basics. |
| 11 | [Comparisons for Three or More Groups](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/11-Comparisons%20for%20Three%20or%20More%20Groups.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | ANOVA families, non-parametric alternatives, Dunn's test, repeated measures, and two-way ANOVA with interactions. |
| 12 | [Post-hoc Analyses and Effect Size](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/12-Post-hoc%20Analyses%20and%20Effect%20Size.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Multiple-comparison procedures (Tukey, Holm, Games-Howell), false discovery rate, and effect sizes. |
| 13 | [Tests for Categorical Data and Proportions](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/13-Tests%20for%20Categorical%20Data%20and%20Proportions.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | One- and two-proportion tests, A/B testing, chi-square independence, Cramér's V, Fisher's exact and McNemar tests. |
| 14 | [Power Analysis and Sample Size Planning](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/14-Power%20Analysis%20and%20Sample%20Size%20Planning.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Effect size, power and sample size, A/B test planning, simulation-based power, and the winner's curse. |
| 15 | [Resampling Methods - Bootstrap and Permutation Tests](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/15-Resampling%20Methods%20-%20Bootstrap%20and%20Permutation%20Tests.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Bootstrap standard errors and confidence intervals (percentile, BCa) and permutation tests for any statistic. |
| 16 | [Correlation and Causality](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/16-Correlation%20and%20Causality.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Correlation metrics, confounding, and causal interpretation limits. |
| 17 | [Introduction to Regression Analysis](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/17-Introduction%20to%20Regression%20Analysis.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Simple linear regression concepts, fitting, and interpretation basics. |
| 18 | [Multiple Linear Regression](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/18-Multiple%20Linear%20Regression.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Multivariable modeling, coefficients, assumptions, and diagnostics. |
| 19 | [Logistic Regression](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/19-Logistic%20Regression.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Binary outcome modeling, odds interpretation, and model evaluation. |
| 20 | [Introduction to Time Series Analysis](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/20-Introduction%20to%20Time%20Series%20Analysis.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Time-indexed data foundations, trend/seasonality, and temporal structure. |
| 21 | [Generalized Linear Models (GLM) and Advanced Techniques](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/21-Generalized%20Linear%20Models%20(GLM)%20and%20Advanced%20Techniques.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | GLM families, link functions, and advanced statistical modeling techniques. |
| 22 | [Model Evaluation and Comparison](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/22-Model%20Evaluation%20and%20Comparison.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Comparing statistical models with fit metrics and validation criteria. |
| 23 | [End-to-End Hypothesis Testing Case Study](../../M06-Statistics%20&%20Inference%20(R)/23-End-to-End%20Hypothesis%20Testing%20Case%20Study.ipynb) | 🟠 Advanced | ✅ | Capstone on real data: two-way ANOVA (ToothGrowth) and Simpson's paradox in UC Berkeley admissions. |
